Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, October 4 · NFL Week 4 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 2, 11:48 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs has the highest SPAGS projection in the Lions at Panthers DraftKings Showdown: 26.1 points at $12,000 FLEX, 39.2 at captain for $18,000. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs holds 74% of the winning-lineup credit.

He also has the largest captain share: 27.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Gibbs at captain. Amon-Ra St. Brown is the next captain in line, at 10.1%. The model gives him 10.5 targets on 31.8 routes.

Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 27 for the Lions and 23.5 for the Panthers.

Behind Gibbs and Brown, the next projections are Jared Goff (18.4, $10,000), Bryce Young (17.8, $9,800) and Chuba Hubbard (15.9, $9,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 2, 11:48 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jahmyr Gibbs, DET RB ($12,000 FLEX / $18,000 CPT)

Jahmyr Gibbs holds 27.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $18,000 and the 26.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 39.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 22.9 carries and 5.7 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 26.2 points with a simulated floor of 14.0 and a ceiling of 42.3. He holds 74% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 27.4% as the captain and 46.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET WR ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Amon-Ra St. Brown holds 10.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 18.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 28.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 10.5 targets on 31.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 37.9. He holds 42% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.1% as the captain and 31.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jalen Coker, CAR WR ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Jalen Coker holds 9.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $11,100 and the 12.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 19.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.7 targets on 31.2 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Coker averaged 12.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.3 and a ceiling of 32.2. He holds 34% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 9.1% as the captain and 24.5% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Lions vs Panthers

Jared Goff, DET QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jared Goff carries the 3rd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 18.4 DraftKings points for a $10,000 FLEX salary ($15,000 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Goff averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 34.3. He holds 51% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.4% as the captain and 43.4% in a FLEX spot.

Bryce Young, CAR QB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Bryce Young carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 17.8 DraftKings points for a $9,800 FLEX salary ($14,700 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Young averaged 17.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 32.9. He holds 49% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.3% as the captain and 42.8% in a FLEX spot.

Chuba Hubbard, CAR RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Chuba Hubbard carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.9 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). The model gives him 17.7 carries and 3.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Hubbard averaged 15.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 30.2. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.0% as the captain and 33.5% in a FLEX spot.

Tetairoa McMillan, CAR WR ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Tetairoa McMillan carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 14.2 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). The model gives him 6.2 targets on 35.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations McMillan averaged 14.0 points with a simulated floor of 3.4 and a ceiling of 35.0. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.1% as the captain and 22.9% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Tommy Tremble, CAR TE ($2,400 FLEX / $3,600 CPT)

Tommy Tremble projects for 5.7 DraftKings points at a $2,400 FLEX salary, 2.39 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.9 targets on 16.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Tremble averaged 5.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.5. He holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.4% as the captain and 22.4% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Darren Waller, CAR TE ($4,400 FLEX / $6,600 CPT)

Darren Waller projects for 8.7 DraftKings points at a $4,400 FLEX salary, 1.98 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 4.3 targets on 20.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Waller averaged 8.6 points with a simulated floor of 0.9 and a ceiling of 23.2. He holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.0% as the captain and 23.3% in a FLEX spot.

Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 27.4%, ahead of Amon-Ra St. Brown (10.1%) and Jalen Coker (9.1%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Lions vs Panthers?

Build around Jahmyr Gibbs at captain with Chuba Hubbard, Sam LaPorta and Jameson Williams at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (17 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,000 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs leads the SPAGS model at 26.1 DraftKings points for $12,000 at FLEX, or 39.2 points at captain for $18,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Lions vs Panthers Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs is the most expensive player at $12,000 FLEX and $18,000 at captain. All 28 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Tommy Tremble (5.7 points at $2,400), Darren Waller (8.7 points at $4,400) and Jake Bates (9.3 points at $5,000).

What is the Lions vs Panthers spread and total?

The Lions are a 3.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 50.5, with implied team totals of 27 for the Lions and 23.5 for the Panthers.
